options.description: A0-A1 to GND: address 0x40 (`address40 = false` to strap them for another address).

notes: High side: IN+ to the supply, IN- to the load, the shunt between them; IN- also measures the bus voltage. Kelvin-connect IN+ and IN- to the shunt pads.
Optional input filter: 10 ohm in series with each input and 0.1-1 uF across IN+ and IN- (Figure 28 RF, CF).
Address by A1/A0: GND/GND 0x40, GND/VS 0x41, GND/SDA 0x42, GND/SCL 0x43, VS/GND 0x44 … SCL/SCL 0x4F (16 addresses).
support.page: Figure 28 typical application circuit; 9.2 (0.1 uF bypass); 8.5.2 Table 1 (addresses)

notes: The common breakout boards use a 0.1 ohm shunt (±3.2 A, ±320 mV PGA range), A0 and A1 pulled down (0x40).
The supply VS (3-5.5 V) is independent of the bus measured (0-26 V).
